description.summary: Utility for generating the common PAM configuration
description.p: pam-config is a command line utility to maintain the common PAM configuration files included by most PAM application configuration files. It can be used to configure a system for different network or hardware based authentication schemes. pam-config can also add/adjust/remove other PAM modules and their options.

The package also has pam-securetty. "pam-securetty enable" restricts logins of root to the consoles it finds on the machine, by writing /etc/securetty and adding pam_securetty to the PAM configuration of login. "pam-securetty disable" takes that away again. Nothing of it is active unless it is enabled.
